title: PREMARKET LIVE: The Trading Floor | Financial Earnings Move the Market
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: Oil staying higher for longer keeps inflation elevated, which could mean a consistent cycle of rate hikes that weighs on the market more than people think.
Money is rotating into XLP, XLF, XLE and utilities, so the S&P looks better than the Nasdaq; he doesn't think they'll stop being defensive.
Market makers have been moving tech put walls down aggressively, a bearish sign; heavy IGV put buying shows hedging.
The AI trade is not busted long term, but equity risk premium will compress P/Es and neoclouds' party is over.
ASML earnings overnight, CPI tomorrow and TSMC after make it a risky stretch to step in front of semis.

calls.reason: S&P rejecting the October value area high but not reaching the point of control; expects sector rotation rather than a big move, with breadth better than Nasdaq.
calls.quote: I don't know that you're really going to go anywhere, but I do think you're going to see a rotation.

calls.reason: NQ sliced through a major level and is rejecting it; QQQ put wall at 740 and put walls being moved down aggressively is bearish for tech. He is short but notes it's oversold and he's usually early on bounces.
calls.quote: they've been moving put walls down pretty aggressively, which is a pretty bearish sign for tech.

calls.condition: If it breaks 524 (VWAP), probably goes to the 500 put wall.
calls.reason: Short SOX and Korea; every prior break of this VWAP led to the put wall, which was dropped back to 500. Feels a bounce is due eventually; AI trade not busted long term.
calls.quote: I would watch 524, and then if you broke that, yeah, you're probably going to 500.

calls.reason: Short the 3x Korea ETF and has raised his stop; expects it to undercut toward 12.
calls.quote: I'm short it... I just think that you probably go to 12 and then figure it out from there.

calls.reason: Massive long-dated call buying; he thinks one of OpenAI/Anthropic will lose and Meta will take a big chunk of AI, with 750 the call wall.
calls.quote: So, I I think Meta's going to win. I think they're going to take a big chunk of it.

calls.reason: Expects iPhone 18 sales weakness as buyers wait for the foldable 'Duo', so the stock comes in first, then rips once Duo pre-sales show strong demand. Long-term holder.
calls.quote: I actually think that you're setting up to come in and then I think when they start seeing the pre-sales of Duo, I think it's going to absolutely rip.

calls.condition: Would buy on a sharp post-earnings drop.
calls.reason: Expects bookings to be 'insane' after price hikes; semiconductors can't exist without ASML, so he wants to buy any big drop for the long term.
calls.quote: I hope they knock it down $200 because I can't wait to buy it.

calls.reason: Every time XLU breaks below its range it holds and returns to the upper range; owns the largest utilities and might add on a pullback.
calls.quote: I like the the utilities here. I I might wait for a pullback

calls.condition: If energy flips its upper channel it can go parabolic.
calls.reason: Oil staying higher for longer lets integrated oil companies 'print money'; they look better than refiners and XLE is ripping.
calls.quote: the integrated oil companies, you know, they actually look really good.

calls.reason: Bank earnings numbers were decent and financials held the 200-day moving average.
calls.quote: financials they held the 200-day moving average... so, they actually look good.

calls.reason: Visa breaking out, possibly on news it may get a credit card license in China; AXP and COF also curling up.
calls.quote: Visa is breaking out... they might be getting a Visa credit card in China.

calls.reason: ZIM crushed earnings and raised guidance with a $6 special dividend; long-time holder, and shipping/tanker names (DHT at highs) look strong.
calls.quote: I've owned this thing forever, and I'm just going to keep holding it.

calls.reason: Neoclouds are rushing to raise money; after a peer couldn't price financing, holders questioned what they own.
calls.quote: The party's over for those neo clouds.

notes: Host says 'Tuesday the 13th' (ZIM event), and ASML reports tonight with CPI tomorrow, so date 2026-10-13. Many cut-off/unclear remarks: AMZN 'watch the 5650 level' (units unclear, skipped), SHOP/SNAP/ACN/UMC/Virtus discussed without clear calls. 'Virtus' near end may be a mis-transcription; he says it 'can break 200 today' (bearish, skipped as ticker unclear).
